messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 — Redwood Private (customer-vpc) telemetry shows sustained auth failures and 5xx from private-proxy between 02:12-02:28 UTC. Pager: @sam. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-099
sam: I'm oncall. Joining the incident channel. Seeing a burst of 500s from proxy-01 and proxy-03 and a spike in API auth errors to KMS during the same time window. Pulling logs now.
lee: I can see KMS Encrypt/Decrypt errors in the control plane for the private deployment. There's also an odd gap in CloudTrail export around 02:15-02:22 UTC for the customer's account. That might block verifying who ran what.
nana: (typo, ignore)
nana: Sorry ignore last — working from phone.
nana: (removed)
nana: (reaction) :eyes:
nana: (note) For clarity, I'm ana from infra and I'll help with host captures.
nana: Wait wrong name in thread. (ignore)
nana: (reaction) :facepalm:
nana: OK back.
nana: Actually I'm ana — apologies for the noise.
nana: Ana here: starting host collection tasks for proxy-01 and proxy-03.
nana: Running disk snapshot + journal export.
nana: Command: ```sudo dd if=/dev/nvme0n1 bs=1M | gzip > /artifacts/INC-2026-099/proxy-01-disk.img.gz```
sam: Mitigation plan (short): 1) failover traffic for that customer's Private control plane to passive region (us-west-2) 2) scale up private-proxies by +2 3) temporarily disable KMS key rotation for that customer until we confirm stability. Executing step 1 now.
infra-bot: Traffic failover executed: private-controlplane -> us-west-2-passive [ok]
infra-bot: Autoscale: added 2 private-proxy instances [ok]
sam: Errors decreasing but we still see auth failures in ~1% of requests. Likely race vs KMS. Lee, can you check KMS key-rotation logs and whether a rotate happened around 02:14?
lee: Checking. I see a scheduled rotate fired at 02:14:10 UTC for alias/customer-vpc-key but CloudTrail shows partial entries; we have missing events for PutKeyPolicy and ReEncrypt during 02:15-02:22. That aligns with the previous observation.
security-ops: Security note: missing CloudTrail entries during incident window. This is a high-risk gap for proof of non-malicious config changes. Initiating evidence preservation workflow.
compliance: Please snapshot the CloudTrail S3 prefix and any audit exports immediately. We need to build the manifest and a chain-of-custody record.
sam: Ana, please copy all host artifacts to secure bucket and generate sha256 checksums. Lee, get KMS console exports and any vendor-side audits.
nana: Copying artifacts to: s3://redwood-secure-evidence/INC-2026-099/artifacts.tar.gz. Generating checksums now.
nana: sha256 CLI snippet: ```sha256sum artifacts.tar.gz | tee sha256.txt && aws s3 cp artifacts.tar.gz s3://redwood-secure-evidence/INC-2026-099/ && aws s3 cp sha256.txt s3://redwood-secure-evidence/INC-2026-099/sha256.txt --acl bucket-owner-full-control```
lee: Exporting KMS audit: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=ReEncrypt --start-time 2026-04-07T02:00:00Z --end-time 2026-04-07T02:30:00Z > kms_reencrypt_events.json```
security-ops: I'm encrypting the sha256 manifest with KMS key KMS-evidence-02 and storing the key policy to incident vault. Also setting S3 prefix ACLs to block all public access and granting READ to {security, compliance, incident-leads}.
compliance: Creating evidence manifest now. Fields will include artifact path, sha256, collected_by, collected_at, signed_by. Please confirm signatures when available.
cs-lead: Customer impact — we saw errors for tenant "enterprise-zen" (high), and degraded performance for "plg-scout" (low). I'm drafting a short notice for affected customers; need incident summary and ETA for final RCA.
sam: Drafting customer summary. Will include mitigation and that we're preserving evidence in case of regulatory requests. I'll share draft to #customer-comms in next 90m.
security-ops: Observed something else: the missing CloudTrail entries correlate with an S3 export job that failed due to IAM role throttling on our export lambda. I've opened SEC-2155 to track. If the export job failed, the logs may never have reached the secure bucket.
lee: That's consistent. There's a lambda retry storm at 02:13 with throttling errors. The lambda was scaled down due to a runaway cold start issue in the canary. We need to decouple CloudTrail export from single-point lambda if that's the root cause.
sam: Handoff: I'm handing over to sre-manager for post-incident follow-ups. SRE-manager, can you own the postmortem, evidence sign-off, and customer comms finalization?
sre-manager: I can take that. Please drop all runbook notes and the incident timeline link in the doc. Also add the artifacts S3 path and the manifest. I'll schedule the postmortem meeting. Proposed slot: 2026-04-09 17:00 UTC (60m). Confirm availability.
cs-lead: Confirmed. I'll be there for customer impact.
security-ops: Confirmed. I'll present the missing audit export analysis and proposed mitigations.
compliance: Confirmed. I'll advise on chain-of-custody wording and regulator notification thresholds.
nana: Evidence collection update: artifacts copied, sha256.txt generated and encrypted. Upload path: s3://redwood-secure-evidence/INC-2026-099/{artifacts.tar.gz,sha256.txt.enc}. I set object-lock for 30 days.
security-ops: Good. Please add the following to the manifest: host-image-id for proxy-01 and proxy-03, kernel logs path, journalctl exports, and KMS event export file name.
lee: Added. KMS export filename: kms_reencrypt_events_2026-04-07.json.
sre-manager: Action items (owners & ETA): - postmortem doc and first-pass RCA (sre-manager) - 2026-04-10 EOD; - investigate CloudTrail export lambda reliability and decouple export (infra/lee) - 2026-04-20; - add alert for KMS Encrypt/Decrypt error rate >0.5% on private control planes (sre) - 2026-04-12; - ensure S3 object-lock and access policy for secure-evidence prefixes (security-ops) - 2026-04-09; - customer comms draft and legal review (cs-lead + legal) - 2026-04-08 EOD; - verify no unauthorized IAM writes during gap (security-ops) - 2026-04-11. Creating tracker tickets now: INF-3499, INF-3500, SEC-2155, COMPL-122.
cs-lead: I'll produce customer-friendly timeline and send to legal for signoff by 2026-04-08 22:00 PDT.
security-ops: For auditability, I'm requesting that evidence be notarized: upload manifest to internal incident vault and record signature using our signing key (sig-key-incident). Will attach to postmortem.
compliance: Note: If any regulated tenant had elevated impact, we must consider notifying their compliance contact. CS-lead, please share tenant list ASAP.
cs-lead: Sharing list now: enterprise-zen (HIGH), plg-scout (LOW). Sending to compliance via DM.
sam: Declaring live mitigation complete at 02:40 UTC after verification of failover and scaling. We'll treat this as resolved for live traffic, but keeping the incident open for postmortem and evidence collection.
sre-manager: Thanks team. Postmortem invite: https://calendar.redwood.internal/event/INC-2026-099-postmortem. Please add any preliminary notes to the doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-099/postmortem. If security/compliance needs anything else before the meeting, reply here and I'll reopen the thread. :white_check_mark:
